variants.title: Detailed full-body title/cutscene model
variants.on_foot: Low-poly versus full-body model, including weapon

contents.body.glb: Self-contained textured model with rigid animated limb nodes, two title or three versus clips at 30 FPS
contents.body.obj: Static frame-zero mesh with body.mtl and external PNG textures
contents.native/: Unmodified native skeletons, limbs, display lists, vertices, textures and animation resources, plus dependency/hash manifests
contents.preview.png: Rendered directly from all six GLB exports
contents.verification.json: Geometry, hierarchy, animation and texture verification results

notes: Preserves original N64 units and Y-up coordinates.
GLB animation uses a rigid node hierarchy rather than a weighted skin.
Root translation is fixed to the limb origin, matching game modes 1/5.
N64 lighting/combiners and runtime character pose overrides are not reproduced.
Native files retain complete original animation data.
